notes:
{建築|けんちく} covers both the field of architecture (design and planning of buildings) and the act of constructing buildings. It functions as a noun and a する verb.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {建築|けんちく}{家|か}: architect
- {建築|けんちく}{物|ぶつ}: building, structure
- {建築|けんちく}{設計|せっけい}: architectural design
- {建築|けんちく}{基準|きじゅん}{法|ほう}: building standards law
- {建築|けんちく}{資材|しざい}: building materials

CONTRAST WITH {建設|けんせつ}:
{建築|けんちく} focuses on buildings and their design. {建設|けんせつ} is broader and includes roads, bridges, dams, and other infrastructure. A {建築|けんちく}{家|か} designs buildings; a {建設|けんせつ}{会社|がいしゃ} may build anything.

VERB USAGE:
{建築|けんちく}する means to construct (a building). Often used in formal or technical contexts.
